FIFO_INFO_REG

Absolute Address:
Base Offset:
0x10
Size:
0x10
Source:

Description

Contains KDMA FIFO bytecount and number of free/busy entries

Contents

Bits Identifier Access Reset Decoded Name
[127:96] RDATA_FREE r 0x0 -
[95:64] WDATA_CONUT r 0x0 -
[63:32] MAX_RD_SIZE r - -
[31:0] MAX_WR_SIZE r - -

Field Descriptions

RDATA_FREE

Number of free entries in DMA read FIFO

WDATA_CONUT

Number of busy entries in DMA write FIFO

MAX_RD_SIZE

Maximum DMA read FIFO bytecount

MAX_WR_SIZE

Maximum DMA write FIFO bytecount
